text:
In my previous situation, I still had one month left on my visa during the interview for my A5. The clerk told me that since I still had a valid visa, they would just call me once they made a decision whether to give me the A5 or simply extend my B1.

So we waited, but no luck. My visa was about to expire the next day, and I still hadn’t received any call or update. That’s why I decided to go to Misrad Hapnim personally to ask.

At first, the guard didn’t want to let me in because I didn’t have an appointment. I argued and explained that my visa was about to expire, and because I was persistent, they finally allowed me inside.

I waited until all the couples finished their interviews. Then the clerk called me and said, “We still don’t have a decision yet, that’s why I didn’t call you.” I told her, “But my visa expires tomorrow.” She went to speak to the manager while I waited outside for a long time.

Then suddenly Gil saw me and greeted me by my name. I was so surprised because I had never even dealt with him before. He asked, “What do you need?” I explained that my visa was about to expire and that I was supposed to receive my A5. He said, “Come, let me check.”

He took my passport, went to the manager, then came back and said, “Fill up this form and come back at 3 PM for your A5.”

. So honestly, I think sometimes it really depends on timing, luck, and maybe even their mood.😂
